name: quarter_car
notes: Active quarter-car: body and wheel masses, suspension spring/damper, tire stiffness.
Active force +u on the body and -u on the wheel.
Road enters as a formal white disturbance through the tire spring channel; it is not a differentiable road-displacement trajectory.
discrete SW from continuous intensity via Van Loan
K and L redesigned for this configuration
Accumulated cost is sum_t (S_t' Qc S_t + U_t' Rc U_t) with no factor of dt.
disclaimer: Spectral radii and Riccati residuals are for the continuous-state linear Gaussian model with the fixed steady-state gains. They do not apply to nonlinear plants or quantized controllers.
